items.title: Interactive Brokers Launches Ethereum Staking Through Zerohash
items.summary: Eligible clients keep at least 70% of staking rewards under the broker’s agreement, while withdrawals remain subject to network waiting periods.

items.title: Anthropic warns ‘AI worms’ may autonomously spread across devices like a virus
items.summary: Anthropic warned that rogue “AI worms” are months away from the ability to self-replicate and autonomously infect user devices such as home appliances and other internet-connected devices.

items.title: Strive buys 3,311 bitcoin for $280 million in largest acquisition since January
South Korea blocks 27 crypto exchanges, including Bitmart and Kucoin
items.summary: The country’s regulators are stepping up their earlier restrictions on mobile apps to websites, targeting unregistered exchanges before investors report losses.
